findings.rule: References should be numbered sequentially as they appear in the text, tables and figure legends.
findings.problem: References [3], [5], [6], [7], [9], [10], [11], and [12] appear in the reference list but are not cited anywhere in the text, tables, or figure legends. Only [1], [2], [4], and [8] are actually cited. The numbering is therefore non-sequential in order of first appearance (it jumps 1, 2, 4, 8) and the list contains eight entries that do not correspond to any in-text citation.

findings.rule: When the Reference has a Digital Object Identifier (DOI), it should be added by its URL. The instructions' own example for an 'in press' article (the identical Itoh et al. Nature paper) includes the DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/nature02212.
findings.problem: Reference [11] reads 'Nature (in press).' with no DOI URL appended, whereas the instructions' example for this exact reference includes 'https://doi.org/10.1038/nature02212'.
